gloss: mediation, bridging, acting as a go-between

definitions.gloss: mediation, bridging, acting as a go-between
definitions.explanation: The act of connecting two parties or serving as an intermediary to facilitate communication or agreement.

examples.japanese: {両者|りょうしゃ}の{橋渡|はしわた}しをする。
examples.english: To act as a mediator between the two parties.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{日本|にほん}と{海外|かいがい}の{橋渡|はしわた}し{役|やく}を{務|つと}めた。
examples.english: He served as a bridge between Japan and overseas.

examples.japanese: {通訳|つうやく}が{言語|げんご}の{橋渡|はしわた}しをしてくれた。
examples.english: The interpreter served as a linguistic bridge.

notes:
{橋渡|はしわた}し refers to mediating or connecting two parties.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {橋渡|はしわた}しをする: to act as a mediator/bridge
- {橋渡|はしわた}し{役|やく}: the role of go-between
- 〜の{橋渡|はしわた}しをする: to bridge ~ (e.g., {文化|ぶんか}の{橋渡|はしわた}しをする)

RELATED TERMS:
- {仲介|ちゅうかい}: mediation (more formal, often business)
- {架|か}け{橋|はし}: bridge, link (more metaphorical)
